item.title: December 16, 1971: The Day Humanity Triumphed Over Indifference
item.description: As Pakistani General A.A.K. Niazi signed the instrument of surrender before Lieutenant General Jagjit Singh Aurora in Dhaka's Ramna Race Course, the world witnesses not merely the conclusion of a thirteen-day war, but the birth of a nation baptized in unimaginable suffering. item.title: Eminent Educationist & Former ASEB Exams Controller Kiran Chandra Deka Passes Away at 93
item.description: Eminent educationist and former Controller of Examinations of the Assam Secondary Education Board (ASEB), Kiran Chandra Deka, passed away on Tuesday at the age of 93. He breathed his last at the Tezpur residence of his daughter, Dr Archana Deka. item.description: In a quiet corner of Assam along the Meghalaya border in Goalpara District, where development remains a distant promise and daily life is shaped by hardship, the Rabha community of Hati Gaon once again came together to celebrate the age-old Horibol Festival, a powerful reminder that tradition, community and dignity can endure even in the most neglected regions. item.description: The owners of the Birch by Romeo Lane nightclub in Goa’s Arpora, brothers Gaurav and Saurabh Luthra, were taken to Goa by the Goa Police after a Delhi court granted a two-day transit remand on Wednesday.
